nodes.label: Supabase Database
nodes.description: Single source of truth for all data: auth, candidates, chat history, profiles, vacancies, notes, status history

nodes.label: OpenAI API
nodes.description: GPT-4o-mini model for natural language candidate search, called via Express backend proxy

nodes.label: Resend Email Service
nodes.description: Email notifications when candidate status changes (interviewed, hired, rejected). Optional integration

nodes.label: n8n Automation
nodes.description: Scrapes candidates from LinkedIn via SerpApi, classifies with OpenRouter/DeepSeek, stores results in Supabase and Google Sheets

nodes.label: Next.js 14 Frontend
nodes.description: React-based frontend application running on port 3002 with App Router architecture

nodes.label: Express Backend
nodes.description: Proxy server for OpenAI API on port 3001, validates Supabase tokens, manages chat history

nodes.label: Super Admin
nodes.description: Full access to all features: create/delete users, manage vacancies, manage candidates, use AI chat, administer pipeline

nodes.label: Recruiter
nodes.description: Manages vacancies and candidates, changes status, adds notes, uses AI chat search

nodes.label: Authentication
nodes.description: Login/logout with email and password, password recovery, persistent sessions via Supabase Auth

nodes.label: Dashboard
nodes.description: Real-time metrics showing candidate distribution, hiring rate, activity feed, pie and bar charts

nodes.label: Vacancy Management
nodes.description: Create, edit, pause, close vacancies with title, company, location, modality, salary range, skills, deadline

nodes.label: Public Apply Portal
nodes.description: Public-facing pages at /apply and /apply/[id] for candidates to view vacancies and submit applications

nodes.label: Candidate Management
nodes.description: Full pipeline management: table view, Kanban board, detail panel with info/notes/history tabs, bulk export

nodes.label: AI Chat Search
nodes.description: Natural language candidate search using GPT-4o-mini with keyword fallback, 6-message conversation context

nodes.label: Search History
nodes.description: Tracks all AI chat searches with query, candidate count, timestamp, ability to repeat searches

nodes.label: User Management
nodes.description: Super Admin panel to view, create, delete users with roles (Recruiter/Super Admin)

nodes.label: Candidate Data Model
nodes.description: Core entity with fields: full_name, position (required), email, phone, experience_years, expected_salary, location, source, resume_url, profile_url, linkedin_url, status, vacancy_id

nodes.label: User Data Model
nodes.description: User entity with id, email, full_name, and role (superAdmin|recruiter)

nodes.label: Vacancy Data Model
nodes.description: Job opening with title, company, location, modality, salary range, experience requirements, skills, deadline, status, applicant count

nodes.label: Candidate Status Enum
nodes.description: Pipeline stages: pending, interviewed, hired, rejected

nodes.label: Vacancy Status Enum
nodes.description: Vacancy states: active (visible to public), paused (hidden, no new applications), closed

nodes.label: Vacancy Modality Enum
nodes.description: Work location types: presencial (on-site), remoto (remote), híbrido (hybrid)

nodes.label: Candidate Source Enum
nodes.description: Origin of candidate: internal (manually created), scraping (n8n/LinkedIn), applicant (public apply portal)

nodes.label: Chat API Endpoint
nodes.description: POST /api/chat - Main backend API for AI-powered candidate search, proxies to OpenAI via Express

nodes.label: User CRUD API Routes
nodes.description: GET/POST/DELETE /api/admin/users - User management via Supabase Admin SDK (requires SERVICE_ROLE_KEY)

nodes.label: Apply API Endpoint
nodes.description: POST /api/apply - Public endpoint for candidate applications and CV upload to Supabase Storage

nodes.label: Notification API Endpoint
nodes.description: POST /api/notify - Email sending via Resend when candidate status changes

nodes.label: Candidates View Component
nodes.description: Main candidates management page with table, Kanban, filters, and detail panel

nodes.label: Chat View Component
nodes.description: AI search interface for natural language candidate queries

nodes.label: Vacancies View Component
nodes.description: Vacancy management interface for creating, editing, pausing, and closing job openings

nodes.label: Apply Landing Component
nodes.description: Public-facing landing page at /apply showing active vacancies for external candidates

nodes.label: Kanban Board Component
nodes.description: Drag-and-drop interface for candidate pipeline with columns: Pending, Interviewed, Hired, Rejected

nodes.label: AI Chat Search Workflow
nodes.description: User message → ChatView → Frontend proxy → Backend Express → OpenAI → Full candidate records → Supabase save

nodes.label: Candidate Status Change Workflow
nodes.description: Recruiter changes candidate status → Updates Supabase → Triggers email notification via Resend → Records in status history

nodes.label: Candidate Application Workflow
nodes.description: Candidate fills /apply form → CV uploads to Supabase Storage → Records in Supabase candidates table with 'applicant' source

nodes.label: Supabase Storage (Resumes)
nodes.description: Public bucket for storing candidate resume PDFs and Word documents, accessible via URL links

nodes.label: Backend Environment Config
nodes.description: Variables: NODE_ENV, PORT, LOG_LEVEL, CORS_ORIGIN, OPENAI_API_KEY, SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
